description: This file defines Express routes for development and debugging purposes, including database status, data seeding, and verification endpoints. It handles external dependencies, models, and route handlers related to MongoDB collections such as users, samples, sessions, deployments, tenants, projects, and LLM costs.

classes.name: Sample
classes.description: A Mongoose model or stub for the 'sample' collection, with fallback in-memory implementation if the model file is missing.

methods.name: GET /api/dev/db-status
methods.description: Returns MongoDB connection status, database name, host, and mongoose state.

methods.name: GET /api/dev/seed
methods.description: Seeds sample data into multiple collections if they are empty, and returns counts and sample documents.

methods.name: GET /api/dev/verify
methods.description: Verifies data availability by returning counts and first few documents from each collection.

methods.name: GET /api/dev/seed-llm-costs
methods.description: Seeds 90 days of LLM cost entries for specific models if the collection is empty, and returns seed info.
